text:
Bitcoin surged past $72,000, triggering over $1 billion in short liquidations alongside an 18% rally in Ethereum above $2,200. Institutional demand accelerated sharply as U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $189.1 million in net daily inflows—the largest single-day haul in nine months—spearheaded by BlackRock's ETHA with $122.1 million.

The aggressive risk-on expansion followed the U.S. Treasury's unexpected announcement to increase sovereign bond buybacks, directly injecting liquidity into fixed-income markets and softening the U.S. dollar. Concurrently, digital asset equity proxies rallied after White House leadership reaffirmed legislative prioritization for the CLARITY Act.

While traditional equity benchmarks like the Nasdaq experienced choppy consolidation under sovereign debt concerns, digital assets decoupled aggressively to the upside. Plunging Treasury yields have compressed real interest rates, creating an optimal macroeconomic backdrop as institutional allocators position for Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's upcoming Jackson Hole keynote.
